engagement_events_shape.name: engagement_events_shape
engagement_events_shape.value:
("engagement_events"."kind" IN ('plan_agreed', 'closed') AND "engagement_events"."milestone_id" IS NULL AND "engagement_events"."amount_inr" IS NULL)
       OR ("engagement_events"."kind" IN ('delivered', 'accepted', 'rejected') AND "engagement_events"."milestone_id" IS NOT NULL AND "engagement_events"."amount_inr" IS NULL)
       OR ("engagement_events"."kind" = 'payment_recorded' AND "engagement_events"."milestone_id" IS NOT NULL AND "engagement_events"."amount_inr" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000)

assessment_events_shape.name: assessment_events_shape
assessment_events_shape.value: ("assessment_events"."kind" = 'decision' AND "assessment_events"."opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_events"."decision" IN ('accept', 'defer', 'reject') AND "assessment_events"."digest" IS NULL) OR ("assessment_events"."kind" = 'signoff' AND "assessment_events"."opportunity_id" IS NULL AND "assessment_events"."decision" IS NULL AND "assessment_events"."digest" IS NOT NULL)

provider_events_shape.name: provider_events_shape
provider_events_shape.value: ("provider_events"."kind" = 'list' AND "provider_events"."terms_version" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_events"."fee_inr" IS NOT NULL) OR ("provider_events"."kind" = 'unlist' AND "provider_events"."terms_version" IS NULL AND "provider_events"."fee_inr" IS NULL)

outcome_events_shape.name: outcome_events_shape
outcome_events_shape.value:
("outcome_events"."kind" = 'baseline' AND "outcome_events"."review_no" IS NULL AND "outcome_events"."verdict" IS NULL AND "outcome_events"."in_use" IS NULL)
       OR ("outcome_events"."kind" = 'review' AND "outcome_events"."review_no" IS NOT NULL AND "outcome_events"."review_no" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "outcome_events"."verdict" IS NOT NULL AND "outcome_events"."verdict" IN ('met', 'partly', 'not_met') AND "outcome_events"."in_use" IS NOT NULL AND "outcome_events"."in_use" IN ('yes', 'no'))
